title: Quality Disappointing
text: Quality Disappointing. Previously, I had purchased two Cast Iron Roosters from this company for my kitchen.  They were attractive and nicely finished.  The finish on this Sunflower Collection piece was marginally satisfactory.  There were areas where the finish was too thin and the guide post had a burr that had to be filed down for safety.  The post then needed to be touched up.  The item was poorly packed and had plenty of room to rattle around in the shipping box.  I would not purchase this particular item again.
